name: BigQuery to Avro + CSV (Flex Template)
description: Reads from a BigQuery table, applies filters and derived columns, writes Avro and CSV to Cloud Storage, and writes invalid rows to dead-letter JSON.

parameters.name: input_table
parameters.label: Input BigQuery table
parameters.helpText: BigQuery table spec in the form PROJECT:DATASET.TABLE

parameters.name: output_prefix
parameters.label: Base GCS output prefix
parameters.helpText: GCS URI prefix for Avro/CSV outputs, e.g. gs://bucket/exports/run1

parameters.name: filter_column
parameters.label: Filter column
parameters.helpText: Optional column name for equality filter, e.g. country.

parameters.name: filter_value
parameters.label: Filter value
parameters.helpText: Optional value for filter_column, e.g. CA.

parameters.name: amount_column
parameters.label: Amount column
parameters.helpText: Numeric column used to derive revenue_band.

parameters.name: csv_columns
parameters.label: CSV columns
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated list of columns for CSV output.

parameters.name: num_shards
parameters.label: Number of shards
parameters.helpText: Number of output shards for Avro and CSV.
